name: review-html-standalone
label: Review HTML (standalone single-file)
_specSource: Variant of review-html for SELF-CONTAINED single-file review HTML — one .html that inlines its own base palette + tokens in a <style> block instead of importing a shared theme file. Same spec roots as review-html (design.md §5 Density Floors · §'Extension governance' · §3 CJK fallback).
_usage: OPT-IN profile · does not auto-detect over normal review-html to avoid detection collision. Select it either by naming the file `*.standalone.html` / `*_standalone.html` (auto-detected by filePattern) OR by forcing it: `node audit.mjs foo.html --surface=review-html-standalone`. Use this whenever a review HTML defines its base tokens (--bg / --ink / --gold / --border ...) inline rather than via an imported theme — otherwise dim-12 mis-reads those inline base tokens as unnamespaced extensions (a real-world case · 16 P1 false-positives).
_cjkRule: Same as review-html: review-HTML status/layer tags render CN in MONO · var(--font-*) tokens trusted. Spec root: design.md §3 'CJK / i18n font fallback'.

extensions.rule: WCAG ratio comment required on each new --color-* extension (design.md §'Extension governance' rule 2). Base palette tokens (--bg / --ink / --gold / --border ...) defined inline with CANONICAL spec colors are treated as base tokens, not extensions — see inlineBaseTokens.
forbidden: extension token without WCAG ratio comment
extensions._inlineBaseTokensNote: When true, dim-12 does NOT flag an unnamespaced color var as an extension IF its value is a canonical spec color (design.md §0 palette). Inline base tokens holding canonical hex = base, not rogue extension. Non-canonical inline hex is still flagged (real drift · also caught by dim-01).
